blocks.text: CORE STANDARD 1.0.0 CANONIZATION RECORD
Status: Gate 3 passed. Era Zero now has 324 canonical atomic roots, 27 in each of 12 families, with zero provisional or missing atomic addresses.
Authority: the 36 source-approved Life and Motion roots remain unchanged. The user directly authorized semantic audit and canonization of the 288 Phase 2 completions.
Semantic audit result
• 324 roots audited against family domain, concept type, orientation, lexical state, triad coherence, synonym separation, compound usefulness, and runtime-state separation.
• 288 Phase 2 definitions promoted without changing any core definition or address.
• 13 short titles clarified to make active-process distinctions explicit.
• No semantic collision required reassignment, definition replacement, or deprecation.
• Validation passed 21 checks and 2,268 atom-field algorithm assertions with zero failures.
Title-only clarifications
• CON:111 transmission → active transmission.
• STR:101 self-organization → active self-organization.
• STR:111 construction → active construction.
• WRN:111 warn or isolate → active warning or isolation.
• REP:101 self-repair → active self-repair.
• REP:111 repair target → active target repair.
• LOG:101 computation → active computation.
• DAT:101 read or decode → active local decoding.
• DAT:111 write or transmit → active data transfer.
• CRE:101 ideation → active ideation.
• CRE:111 create artifact → active artifact creation.
• ORI:101 becoming → active becoming.
• ORI:111 manifest → active manifestation.
These are label clarifications only. Their canonical core definitions, addresses, encodings, and meanings are unchanged.
Collision watchlist dispositions
• REP:010 is a repaired target condition; REP:111 is the active outward repair process.
• MIN:001 is present attention as a mental condition; MIN:201 is currently available focus capacity.
• MIN:202 is latent learning aptitude; CRE:202 is untapped form-generating creativity.
• MAT:200 is physical-substrate integrity; STR:200 is organized load, containment, or ordering capacity.
• CON:020 is a communication topology; DAT:020 is a bounded collection of records.
• DAT:002 is one local dormant record; DAT:022 is a collective archive.
• CRE:020 is a stable design system; CRE:220 is the relational design space among forms and constraints.
• STR:222 is an unrealized architecture inside reality; ORI:222 is an unrealized reality-and-law system.
• WRN:222 is an unrealized catastrophe; ORI:222 is ontological possibility without inherent danger.
• MIN:222 is a mental hypothesis space; LOG:222 is a formally valid proof, program, or solution space.
Canonical ORI / num decision

ORI:002 is nu·nan, “latent first condition.” Runtime state 2 is named num. num is not an alternate canonical atomic form for ORI:002 in version 1.0.0. Possible historical contraction use belongs in the later etymology layer.
Cyber-pet compound consequence

The earlier provisional compound LIF:010 + CRE:020 + DAT:210 is not promoted automatically because CRE:020 now canonically means “design system,” not an individual created artifact. Gate 4 must compare LIF:010 + CRE:010 + DAT:210 with a fuller semantic graph before approving the canonical cyber-pet compound.
Change control

Era Zero Core Standard 1.0.0 is frozen at the atomic-root layer. Future semantic changes to a canonical root require an explicit versioned migration; silent changes are prohibited. The Phase 2 proposal files remain preserved as audit history.
Next authorized gate

Gate 4 is the compound and coverage layer: canonical compounds, English concept index, expressibility gaps, and the Era Zero–Three etymology table. The broad English translator remains deferred until the semantic IR, formal grammar, and deterministic renderer are complete.
End of Era Zero Core Standard 1.0.0 canonization record.
USER AUTHORITY CORRECTION — GATE 3 WITHDRAWAL
Affected audit record: CORE STANDARD 1.0.0 CANONIZATION RECORD
Approval status: WITHDRAWN BEFORE DOWNSTREAM IMPLEMENTATION BY USER DIRECTION

This later user direction supersedes the earlier Gate 3 semantic-promotion decision. The prior canonization record and 32 promoted chunk records remain preserved as audit history, but they are not current semantic authority.
Current authority:
• Era Zero Core Architecture 1.0 remains fixed.
• The 36 source-developed roots remain canonical: LIF:000–222 and MOV:000–022. Their approved meanings are unchanged.
• The other 288 addresses retain their deterministic family, address, universal slot, harmonic signature, family onset, local compact root, formal carrier, and relative note path.
• Their semantic titles and definitions are PROVISIONAL — PENDING DETAILED SEMANTIC REVIEW.
• No compound architecture, English concept index, etymology layer, semantic IR, grammar implementation, renderer, or translator may depend on those provisional meanings.

Active review packet: MOV:100–122. A separate detailed companion review now contains first-principles candidates, invariant definitions, address and boundary analysis, triplet and entity contrasts, runtime interpretations, examples, coverage tests, collision audit, confidence ratings, and an approval checklist. The nine proposed meanings are not canonical.
Stop boundary: do not begin MOV:200–222 or Gate 4 without later user authorization.
Final challenge review for MOV:100–122 is complete and remains pending user approval.
USER APPROVAL — MOV:100–122 SEMANTIC CANONIZATION

The user explicitly approved the final adversarial recommendations for MOV:100–122. The packet passed detailed semantic review and final challenge. These nine meanings are canonical; their deterministic generated fields are unchanged; the original 36 source-canonical roots remain unchanged.

Architecture clarification: for every process address 1x2, lexical trit 2 denotes a nonactualized family-domain process that is not presently active or completed and whose realization is dormant, potential, or unresolved. It does not by itself encode event specification, intention, planning, scheduling, queuing, permission, readiness, probability, future time, certainty, or guaranteed occurrence. Runtime [2]/num remains the separate current-status marker for a token of the selected root.
MOV:100 — completed source departure — Completion of a mover’s displacement away from a source position.
MOV:101 — active source departure — Ongoing displacement of a mover away from a source position.
MOV:102 — potential source departure — A potential displacement away from a source position that is not presently active or completed.
MOV:110 — completed target arrival — Completion of a mover’s displacement to a target position.
MOV:111 — active target approach — Ongoing displacement of a mover toward a target position.
MOV:112 — potential target approach — A potential displacement toward a target position that is not presently active or completed.
MOV:120 — completed shared-frame movement — Completion of a mover’s change of position relative to a shared or environmental reference frame.
MOV:121 — active shared-frame movement — Ongoing change of a mover’s position relative to a shared or environmental reference frame.
MOV:122 — potential shared-frame movement — A potential change of a mover’s position relative to a shared or environmental reference frame that is not presently active or completed.

Route traversal is not atomic in this block. It remains reserved for later composition using shared-frame movement plus MOV:020 established route. Scheduling, queuing, intention, permission, readiness, and probability remain outside these roots. Future semantic changes require an explicit versioned migration.
Current semantic authority: 45 canonical roots and 279 provisional roots. The broad Gate 3 promotion remains withdrawn; this is a separate selective approval.
MOV:200–222 REVIEW STATUS

The nine-root peer-review packet is complete and remains noncanonical pending user decision. Its recommended architecture is self-mobility capacity (enduring / available / latent), target-relative position (established / live / unresolved), and shared-frame positional configuration (established / live / unrealized possible). All nine recommendations are ready for user approval. No MAT block, other root block, compound architecture, or Gate 4 work has begun.
